Native intent binds format/request/expectedRuleVersion; original rentemester-original-journal-mcp/1 binds original request minus confirm/key, including lower-priority selectors.

retry.tombstone: Durable key tombstone survives outcome expiry; missing/expired result refuses, never permits repost. Imported key requires explicit restored-receipt reconciliation; original keyed ABI refuses reconciled provenance rather than discard it.
retry.naturalDedup: Exact-intent receipt replay under current admission; not unkeyed dedup. Reversal separately refuses already reversed original.
retry.readBack: Canonical journal/current principal receipt metadata; native browser opted-in recovery inventory only, no fabricated recover CLI/MCP alias. Preserve exact original key/envelope; reconcile evidence before deliberate exact replay. Missing result never grants new key/repost.
retry.unresolvedProvider: No provider execution or live approval claimed; no external provider replay guarantee.

refusal.note: Known keyed business refusal is HTTP200 {ok:false,code,errors}, wrapped as {ok:false,data:{ok:false,code,errors}}, isError:true. SDK transport/admission errors use the distinct error wrapper. Text JSON equals structuredContent.
